blogs.title: Why Your Next Phone Might Run a Giant AI Model: The Magic of 1-Bit LLMs
blogs.description: Explore how BitNet b1.58 shrinks massive AI models down to just 1.58 bits per parameter, making it possible to run powerful language models on smartphones and edge devices without draining the battery or requiring cloud servers.

blogs.title: From Math to Logic: How 1-Bit Models Replace Trillions of Calculations
blogs.description: Dive into the 'new computation paradigm' where complex floating-point multiplications are replaced by simple integer additions. Learn why switching from 16-bit to ternary {-1, 0, 1} weights slashes energy consumption by over 70x and speeds up inference dramatically.

blogs.title: The New Scaling Law: Why Bigger Isn't Always Better (Unless It's 1.58 Bits)
blogs.description: Unpack the surprising finding that a 3-billion parameter BitNet b1.58 model matches the performance of full-precision giants while using a fraction of the memory and latency. Discover how this redefines the rules for training future AI systems.

blogs.title: Beyond the Chip: Designing Custom Hardware for the Era of Ternary AI
blogs.description: Discuss how the unique architecture of BitNet b1.58 opens the door for specialized hardware designs (like LPUs) that bypass traditional bottlenecks in memory bandwidth and power, potentially revolutionizing data center efficiency and mobile computing.
